John Main was first elected in 2017 to serve in the 5th Legislative Assembly of Nunavut as the Member for Arviat North-Whale Cove. He was subsequently re-elected in 2021 and 2025 to serve in the 6th and 7th Legislative Assemblies.

Mr. Main was elected as Premier of Nunavut during the Nunavut Leadership Forum’s proceedings of November 18, 2025.
